msg.dn.help:
§e/dn command overview§r, type §b/dn <command> help§r for details:
  §aopen§r open warehouse/Special Ops/workbench overview
  §areload§r reload all configs
  §aexport§r export config backup
  §asetting§r global settings
  §awarehouse§r warehouse config
  §asafe§r safe box
  §agrid§r grid-inventory config
  §aclass§r item class config
  §aperm§r permissions
  §ainfo§r show current config
  §aworkbench§r workbench management
  §arecipe§r recipe management
  §atree§r upgrade tree management
  §adata§r player data
  §aweb§r web editor
msg.dn.help.open:
§e/dn open§r open UIs
§aUsage§r:
  /dn open warehouse open the warehouse
  /dn open special open Special Ops
  /dn open manufacture open the workbench overview
msg.dn.help.reload: §e/dn reload§r hot-reloads recipes, the upgrade tree and workbenches without a restart
msg.dn.help.export: §e/dn export§r exports all recipes to config/deltanexus/backup/
msg.dn.help.setting:
§e/dn setting§r global settings
§aUsage§r:
  /dn setting speed <multiplier> crafting speed multiplier, 0.01 ~ 100, new tasks only
  /dn setting queue <size> max parallel queue per workbench, 1 ~ 100
  /dn setting mode offline|online crafting timer mode
  /dn setting currency item <itemId> item currency
  /dn setting currency scoreboard <objective> scoreboard currency
  /dn setting currency vault Vault economy
  /dn setting currency playerpoints PlayerPoints points
msg.dn.help.warehouse:
§e/dn warehouse§r warehouse config
§aUsage§r:
  /dn warehouse rows <rows> total warehouse rows, 1 ~ 64, 9 slots each
  /dn warehouse slots <count> base unlocked slots, 0 ~ 576
§aNote§r: max level comes from the upgrade tree; rows auto-expand when the tree unlocks more slots than the current capacity.
msg.dn.help.info:
§e/dn info§r show the current full config
§aUsage§r: /dn info
msg.dn.help.workbench:
§e/dn workbench§r workbench management
§aUsage§r:
  /dn workbench list list all workbenches
  /dn workbench add <id> <name> add a workbench
  /dn workbench remove <id> remove a workbench
  /dn workbench rename <id> <new name> rename a workbench
msg.dn.help.recipe:
§e/dn recipe§r recipe management
§aQuery§r:
  /dn recipe list <workbenchId> list recipes
  /dn recipe get <recipeId> show details
§aAdd/Remove§r:
  /dn recipe add <workbenchId> <recipeId> create an empty recipe
  /dn recipe remove <recipeId> delete a recipe
  /dn recipe rename <recipeId> <name> set the display name
§aInput/Output§r, held item includes NBT:
  /dn recipe addinput <recipeId> add an input
  /dn recipe addoutput <recipeId> add an output
  /dn recipe delinput <recipeId> <index> remove an input
  /dn recipe deloutput <recipeId> <index> remove an output
  /dn recipe setinput <recipeId> <index> <count> set input count
  /dn recipe setoutput <recipeId> <index> <count> set output count
§aProperties§r:
  /dn recipe time <recipeId> <seconds> set duration
  /dn recipe level <recipeId> <level> set required warehouse level
  /dn recipe parallel <recipeId> <limit> set max parallel crafts
§aReload§r:
  /dn recipe reload reload all recipes
msg.dn.help.tree:
§e/dn tree§r upgrade tree management
§aNote§r: max warehouse level = highest level in the tree; rows auto-expand when unlocked slots exceed capacity.
§aQuery§r:
  /dn tree get show the upgrade tree
§aLevel nodes§r:
  /dn tree add <level> add an empty level
  /dn tree remove <level> remove a level
  /dn tree cost <level> <cost> set the cost
  /dn tree slots <level> <slots> set unlock slots
§aMaterials§r, held item includes NBT:
  /dn tree additem <level> add a required material
  /dn tree delitem <level> <index> remove a material
  /dn tree setitem <level> <index> <count> set material count
msg.dn.help.data:
§e/dn data <player>§r set player warehouse/safe box data
§aNote§r: setting a level unlocks tree slots for it, only increases; the target's GUI refreshes automatically.
§aUsage§r:
  /dn data <player> get show the data
  /dn data <player> level <level> set warehouse level
  /dn data <player> slots <count> set unlocked slots
  /dn data <player> safe <level> set safe box level
  /dn data <player> reset reset warehouse and safe box, items kept
msg.dn.help.safe:
§e/dn safe§r safe box config
§aNote§r: the safe box is a small personal storage, default 1x1, max 3x3; level 0 = default size, higher levels unlock rows x cols via the upgrade tree.
§aConfig§r:
  /dn safe size <width> <height> default size, 1 ~ 3 x 1 ~ 3
  /dn safe get show default size and upgrade tree
§aUpgrade tree§r:
  /dn safe add <level> add an empty level
  /dn safe remove <level> remove a level
  /dn safe cost <level> <cost> set the cost
  /dn safe rows <level> <rows> <cols> set unlock rows x cols
  /dn safe additem <level> add a required material
  /dn safe delitem <level> <index> remove a material
  /dn safe setitem <level> <index> <count> set material count
§aNBT restrictions§r, items with the given NBT cannot be placed into the safe box:
  /dn safe restrict <item|any> <exact|contains> <nbt> add a restriction
  /dn safe restrictions list restrictions
  /dn safe unrestrict <index> remove a restriction

msg.dn.help.class:
§e/dn class§r item class config
§aNote§r: an item belongs to one class, which tints the wall behind multi-slot items; stored in config/deltanexus/grid_classes.json, equivalent to /dn grid class.
§aUsage§r:
  /dn class list show all classes and item assignments
  /dn class set <name> <R> <G> <B> set class color, 0 ~ 255, creates if missing
  /dn class remove <name> remove a class
  /dn class setclass <itemId> <name> assign an item to a class
  /dn class unsetclass <itemId> remove the item class
msg.dn.help.grid:
§e/dn grid§r grid-inventory config
§aNote§r: manages item footprints, hotbar rules and class background colors, synced to clients automatically; only items with a configured size are larger than 1x1.
§aItem footprint§r:
  /dn grid list show custom sizes/hotbar rules
  /dn grid size <width> <height> set held item footprint, 1 ~ 9 each
  /dn grid remove <itemId> remove a custom size
  /dn grid hotbar <rules> set hotbar rules, e.g. 0-3:ANY,4-8:GRID
§aClasses§r, equivalent to /dn class:
  /dn class list show classes and item assignments
  /dn class set <name> <R> <G> <B> set class color
  /dn class remove <name> remove a class
  /dn class setclass <itemId> <name> assign an item to a class
  /dn class unsetclass <itemId> remove the item class
msg.dn.help.web:
§e/dn web§r web editor
§aUsage§r:
  /dn web show status and URL
  /dn web on start and enable auto-start
  /dn web off stop and disable auto-start
§aConfig§r: config/deltanexus/web-editor.yml, file-editable only
msg.dn.help.perm:
§e/dn perm§r permissions
§aNote§r: controls who can open the warehouse, recipe workbench, Special Ops and safe box; OPs are exempt by default; stored in config/deltanexus/permissions.json, targets support @a/@p/@s/@r/@e selectors.
§aUsage§r:
  /dn perm get [target] show global defaults and player overrides
  /dn perm set <target> <warehouse|workbench|special|safe_box|all> <allow|deny> set a player override
  /dn perm remove <target> remove an override
  /dn perm default <warehouse|workbench|special|safe_box|all> <allow|deny> set the global default
  /dn perm op <allow|deny> set whether OPs are exempt
  /dn perm getop show OP exemption state
msg.dn.help.feature:
§e/dn feature§r mod feature toggle
§aNote§r: disabled players lose all mod features and every UI reverts to vanilla; stored in config/deltanexus/permissions.json.
§aUsage§r:
  /dn feature get [target] show the toggle state
  /dn feature set <target> <allow|deny> enable/disable all mod features for the target
